# NEUD Alpha v0.3.1 color-only refresh

Derived from the approved application icon `desktop/assets/icon.png` (deep navy / electric blue / violet).

## Restriction

**Colors only.** No layout, typography, spacing, radii, animation, or behavior changes in this change set.
